items.title: Spec-Driven Development with Kiro IDE: Building AI-Aligned Software Through Living Specifications
items.summary: As Artificial Intelligence becomes increasingly capable of generating code, the challenges of software development are shifting from writing code to defining requirements, managing complexity, maintaining control, and ensuring that AI-generated solutions align with human intentions.Spec-Driven Development (SDD) introduces a structured approach in which specifications become the central source of truth, guiding AI agents throughout the software development lifecycle.In this presentation, Haim Michael explores how Kiro IDE, Amazon's agentic development environment, supports Spec-Driven Development and enables developers to build reliable, maintainable, and AI-aligned software.The presentation covers several key topics:The End of Code-First Development: Understanding why AI-generated code shifts the bottleneck from implementation to specification, coordination, and verification.The Limitations of Prompt-Driven Development: Exploring why relying on individual prompts makes it difficult to preserve intent, trace decisions, and maintain consistency.Spec-Driven Development: Using living specifications to capture requirements, constraints, architecture, and acceptance criteria.Kiro IDE and Its Ecosystem: Introducing Kiro IDE, CLI, Web, Mobile, and Crew.The Development Process: Moving from steering documents and EARS-based requirements to technical design, implementation tasks, and AI-assisted execution.Agent Hooks: Automating recurring activities such as code reviews, security checks, testing, formatting, and documentation.Subagents and Parallel Execution: Delegating specialized tasks to AI agents and executing independent development tasks concurrently.Kiro Workflows: Orchestrating complex, multi-step development processes using sequential tasks, parallel agents, and iterative loops.Cloud-Based AI Agents: Enabling autonomous agents to handle long-running activities, monitoring, incident response, code reviews, and recurring tasks.Persistent Orchestration and Observability: Using Kiro Crew to coordinate ongoing activities while maintaining visibility into agent execution, approvals, and results.Best Practices: Keeping specifications updated, maintaining detailed steering documents, reviewing technical designs, optimizing AI capabilities through MCP servers, Skills, and Powers, and choosing the appropriate level of orchestration.The central message is that the future of software development is not about generating more code. It is about defining intent precisely, orchestrating AI agents effectively, and maintaining control over the entire development process.As code generation becomes increasingly inexpensive, software developers move to a higher level of abstraction, focusing on architecture, requirements, constraints, quality assurance, and coordination.Living specifications become the foundation that keeps humans and AI agents aligned, enabling software systems to evolve without losing their original intent.About the SpeakerHaim Michael is the Founder and CEO of Zindell Technologies, a software architect, author, university lecturer, and technology trainer with more than 25 years of programming experience. He is also a Kiro Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, and Oracle ACE Associate.Website: https://blog.lifemichael.comLinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/lifemichaelKiro IDE: https://kiro.dev

items.title: Software Developers Evolution in the Era of AI
items.summary: Artificial Intelligence is fundamentally transforming software development. As AI becomes increasingly capable of generating code, software developers' roles are shifting from writing code to designing systems, defining requirements, making architectural decisions, and orchestrating AI agents.In this presentation, Haim Michael explores the skills, mindsets, and professional capabilities developers need to remain relevant and thrive in the AI era.The presentation covers several key topics:English Proficiency and Specifications: Why clear communication, precise requirements, and specification-driven development are becoming essential.T-Shaped Professionals: The growing importance of combining deep technical expertise with broader interdisciplinary skills.AI as a Development Partner: Moving beyond traditional coding toward collaborative development with AI.Mental Models: Prioritizing fundamental concepts such as state, flow, abstraction, composition, and trade-offs over memorizing syntax and APIs.Writing and System Design: Developing the ability to translate human intent into clear requirements, design system architectures, and establish boundaries.Debugging and Code Review: Understanding, evaluating, and verifying AI-generated code while maintaining responsibility for software quality.Becoming System Builders: Expanding beyond programming to understand business requirements, product development, and UI/UX considerations.Continuous Self-Learning: Navigating rapidly evolving technologies, prioritizing learning objectives, and using AI as a personal learning accelerator.The central message is that the future of software development is not simply about writing code faster. It is about moving to a higher level of abstraction, where developers define what needs to be built, understand why it matters, and guide AI systems toward reliable outcomes.As generating code becomes increasingly inexpensive, software developers' real value shifts toward critical thinking, architectural understanding, clear specifications, continuous learning, and the ability to orchestrate the software development process.About the SpeakerHaim Michael is the Founder and CEO of Zindell Technologies, a software architect, author, lecturer, and technology trainer with more than 25 years of programming experience. He teaches advanced computer science topics at universities and actively contributes to the international software development community.Website: https://blog.lifemichael.comLinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/lifemichael
